description: This file declares functions related to engine timing advance calculations, including getting advance based on RPM and load, initializing timing maps, and building timing maps.

methods.name: getAdvance
methods.description: Returns the ignition advance angle based on engine RPM and load.

methods.name: setDefaultIatTimingCorrection
methods.description: Sets default Inlet Air Temperature timing correction.

methods.name: initTimingMap
methods.description: Initializes the timing map with current engine parameters.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates the maximum ignition advance based on engine bore, compression, octane rating, and chamber style.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Computes initial ignition advance based on RPM, map value, and maximum advance.

methods.name: buildTimingMap
methods.description: Constructs a timing map with specified maximum advance.
